description: [alias of cuba_pizarra] Working memory buffer (v0.9, Baddeley 1992): a TTL-bounded scratchpad orthogonal to episodic and semantic memory. Use for inter-step plan state during long-horizon agent tasks, tentative observations, cross-tool-call reminders inside one session. Auto-expire by ttl_seconds; bulk-purged by cuba_zafra REM cycle.

allow_secret.description: Refused when the text looks like a live credential (token, password, URL with embedded creds). Set true only for a false match — the text is then stored verbatim, in clear, and reachable by search, export and every client.

tag.description: Optional tag for filtering on read/clear

name: memory_pizarra
